name: @spacedatanetwork/terrain-source
description: Terrain DEM tiling module: decodes open DEM source responses (Copernicus GeoTIFF granules for Earth, PDS LOLA products for the Moon), emits terrain tile records (water-mask channel on Earth, oct normals on a body) and packs a body's records into published files. Pure transform; scheduling lives in the sibling terrain-ingest module.
